attributes.title: Codex CLI — Conversations
attributes.description: Logs-based usage summary — one row per Codex conversation (STATS BY labels.conversation_id) over logs-apm.app.codex_cli_rs*. An ES|QL saved Discover session (no data view / filter pills). Rolls up the trace_safe event family and the log_only token-usage docs into per-conversation totals: first/last seen, wall-clock duration (sec), doc count, distinct user prompts / LLM requests / tool results, cached vs non-cached input and output token sums, error count, and distinct traces. Sorted by last_seen DESC. The session-level companion to Turns (per-turn, traces-based).

kibanaSavedObjectMeta.searchSourceJSON:
{"query":{"esql":"FROM logs-apm.app.codex_cli_rs*
 | WHERE labels.conversation_id IS NOT NULL
 | EVAL ts_ms = TO_LONG(@timestamp)
 | EVAL is_log_only = service.framework.name == "codex_otel.log_only"
 | EVAL is_trace_safe = labels.target == "codex_otel.trace_safe"
 | EVAL is_user_prompt = is_trace_safe AND labels.event_name == "codex.user_prompt"
 | EVAL is_llm_request = is_trace_safe AND labels.event_name == "codex.websocket_request"
 | EVAL is_tool_result = is_trace_safe AND labels.event_name == "codex.tool_result"
 | EVAL is_token_usage = is_log_only AND labels.input_token_count IS NOT NULL
 | EVAL cached_input_token_count = CASE(is_token_usage, numeric_labels.cached_token_count, null)
 | EVAL non_cached_input_token_count = CASE(is_token_usage, TO_LONG(labels.input_token_count) - numeric_labels.cached_token_count, null)
 | EVAL output_token_count = CASE(is_token_usage, TO_LONG(labels.output_token_count), null)
 | EVAL is_error = labels.success == "false" OR labels.error_message IS NOT NULL
 | STATS
     first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
     last_seen = MAX(@timestamp),
     duration_sec = (MAX(ts_ms) - MIN(ts_ms)) / 1000,
     docs = COUNT(*),
     user_prompts = COUNT_DISTINCT(CASE(is_user_prompt, span.id, null)),
     llm_requests = COUNT_DISTINCT(CASE(is_llm_request, span.id, null)),
     tool_results = COUNT_DISTINCT(CASE(is_tool_result, labels.call_id, null)),
     cached_input_tokens = SUM(cached_input_token_count),
     non_cached_input_tokens = SUM(non_cached_input_token_count),
     output_tokens = SUM(output_token_count),
     errors = SUM(CASE(is_error, 1, 0)),
     traces = COUNT_DISTINCT(trace.id)
   BY conversation_id = labels.conversation_id
 | SORT last_seen DESC"},"filter":[]}

attributes.title: Codex CLI — Turns
attributes.description: Traces-based turn summary — one row per Codex turn (STATS BY labels.turn_id) over traces-apm-agents_codex_cli_rs*. An ES|QL saved Discover session (no data view / filter pills). For each turn: first/last seen, the session_task.turn span duration (sec), conversation_id (labels.thread_id), doc count, distinct LLM requests (run_sampling_request) and MCP calls (mcp.tools.call), per-turn token usage (cached / non-cached input, output), error count (event.outcome == failure), and trace id. Sorted by last_seen DESC. The turn-level companion to Conversations (per-conversation, logs-based).

kibanaSavedObjectMeta.searchSourceJSON:
{"query":{"esql":"FROM traces-apm-agents_codex_cli_rs*
 | WHERE labels.turn_id IS NOT NULL AND labels.turn_id != ""
 | EVAL is_session_turn = span.name == "session_task.turn"
 | EVAL is_llm_request = span.name == "run_sampling_request"
 | EVAL is_mcp_call = span.name == "mcp.tools.call"
 | EVAL is_error = event.outcome == "failure"
 | STATS
     first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
     last_seen = MAX(@timestamp),
     duration_sec = MAX(CASE(is_session_turn, span.duration.us / 1000000, null)),
     conversation_id = VALUES(labels.thread_id),
     docs = COUNT(*),
     llm_requests = COUNT_DISTINCT(CASE(is_llm_request, span.id, null)),
     mcp_calls = COUNT_DISTINCT(CASE(is_mcp_call, span.id, null)),
     cached_input_tokens = SUM(numeric_labels.codex_turn_token_usage_cached_input_tokens),
     non_cached_input_tokens = SUM(numeric_labels.codex_turn_token_usage_non_cached_input_tokens),
     output_tokens = SUM(numeric_labels.codex_turn_token_usage_output_tokens),
     errors = SUM(CASE(is_error, 1, 0)),
     trace_id = VALUES(trace.id)
   BY turn_id = labels.turn_id
 | SORT last_seen DESC"},"filter":[]}

attributes.title: Codex CLI — Turn Timeline (Events) (Deprecated)
attributes.description: DEPRECATED / lab-reference logs timeline — the events-stream view of a turn's execution, superseded by Turn Timeline (Traces). An ES|QL saved Discover session over logs-apm.app.codex_cli_rs*. Classifies each trace_safe event doc into an event_type (user_prompt / llm_request / tool_call) and a success/error status, sorted by @timestamp DESC. Kept as a reference for how the logs stream models a turn; for the primary execution timeline use Turn Timeline (Traces), which captures the full span hierarchy (turn / tool catalogue / …) the logs stream omits.

kibanaSavedObjectMeta.searchSourceJSON:
{"query":{"esql":"FROM logs-apm.app.codex_cli_rs*
 | EVAL event_type = CASE(
     labels.target == "codex_otel.trace_safe" AND labels.event_name == "codex.user_prompt", "user_prompt",
     labels.target == "codex_otel.trace_safe" AND labels.event_name == "codex.websocket_request", "llm_request",
     labels.target == "codex_otel.trace_safe" AND labels.event_name == "codex.tool_result", "tool_call",
     null
 )
 | WHERE event_type IS NOT NULL
 | EVAL status = CASE(
     labels.success == "false" OR labels.error_message IS NOT NULL, "error",
     labels.success == "true", "success"
   )
 | SORT @timestamp DESC"},"filter":[]}

attributes.title: Codex CLI — Turn Timeline (Traces)
attributes.description: Primary execution timeline — one row per span in a Codex turn, over traces-apm-agents_codex_cli_rs*. An ES|QL saved Discover session (no data view / filter pills). Scopes to turn/submission spans, classifies each by span.name into an event_type (turn / user_prompt / llm_request / tool_catalogue / tool_call), derives duration_ms (span.duration.us / 1000) and a success/error status from event.outcome, and shows per-turn token usage, sorted by @timestamp DESC. The canonical Codex execution timeline (the traces stream carries the full span hierarchy); Turn Timeline (Events) is its deprecated logs-stream predecessor.

kibanaSavedObjectMeta.searchSourceJSON:
{"query":{"esql":"FROM traces-apm-agents_codex_cli_rs*
 | WHERE (labels.turn_id IS NOT NULL AND labels.turn_id != "") OR labels.submission_id IS NOT NULL
 | EVAL event_type = CASE(
     span.name == "session_task.turn", "turn",
     span.name == "op.dispatch.user_input", "user_prompt",
     span.name == "run_sampling_request", "llm_request",
     span.name == "built_tools", "tool_catalogue",
     span.name == "mcp.tools.call", "tool_call",
     null
   )
 | WHERE event_type IS NOT NULL
 | EVAL duration_ms = span.duration.us / 1000
 | EVAL status = CASE(
     event.outcome == "failure", "error",
     event.outcome == "success", "success",
     null
   )
 | SORT @timestamp DESC"},"filter":[]}
